comment: Read at commit 1fc62fa, the only commit carrying the installed 2.0.4 and byte for byte the installed plugin.json. Four of the nine ParamIds are dead: PARAM_F0, PARAM_OSC_TYPE, PARAM_PITCH_IN_AMT and PARAM_KEYB_SCALE are never given a configParam and never given a widget, so they have no tooltip, no position and no way of being reached; F0 and OSC_TYPE are still read at crystal.cpp:75, where with no ParamQuantity they always return zero. The automatic reset condition at crystal.cpp:101 is written as ((cv1 > cv2) > cv3), a chained comparison: the left side becomes 0 or 1 and is then compared against the third input, so any third-input voltage below 0V makes the condition true whatever the other two read, and the module restarts every voice every 1024 samples. Since the third input is the pitch input, that means every pitch below C4 retriggers the whole bank continuously. Voice 0 is processed twice per sample, once for each detune output at crystal.cpp:147 and :148, so it runs at twice the rate of the other voices and the two side outputs get different consecutive samples of it. The volume knob is treated as power decibels, ten to the power of the value over ten, which is half the usual amplitude decibel law. Nothing here is polyphonic and the plugin adds no context menu items.
